topline: Brutal end to October: the Nasdaq fell 2.86% (worst day since June) and is now about 8% below its 6 Oct high; VWRP fell 1.7% to £140.68, 4.4% off its high.
Intel's ~30% collapse set off a global chip sell-off: Nvidia -4.2% to $204.64, Fabrinet -6.1% to $327.29 ahead of Monday's results.
Amazon recovered from a 7% pre-market drop to close 1.4% lower; Alphabet -1.4% (Wells Fargo target cut to $371), Meta -1.5% and now over 20% off its high. Autodesk bucked the trend, +3.3%.
Gold broke below $3,900 to a one-year low (SGLN -3.1% to a 52-week low) as December Fed hike odds hit ~75%; cyber names fell 3-4% and ISPY dropped 3.7%.
Coming up Monday after the US close: Grab and Fabrinet results; US midterms Tuesday, Bank of England Thursday, Vistra and US jobs on Friday.
